name: Summarise modules, then write an overview
description: Each module is read and summarised by a two-step body, three modules at a time; an agent then writes one overview from all the summaries.

steps.instructions: List the main responsibilities of the module named by your input.
Turn the list you receive into a one-paragraph summary.

agent.instructions: Write an architecture overview from the module summaries you receive as a JSON array of {item, output}.
